I can't see the meal after eating, so the leftover figure is a guess. The calorie and macronutrient numbers below come from rough portion estimates for each item.

| Item | kcal | Protein (g) | Carbs (g) | Fat (g) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lasagna, about 250 g | 420 | 22 | 36 | 20 |
| Brownie | 250 | 3 | 33 | 12 |
| Orange juice, about 200 ml | 90 | 1.5 | 21 | 0.5 |
| Lemonade or cloudy apple juice, about 200 ml | 80 | 0 | 20 | 0 |
| Mixed vegetables | 60 | 2 | 12 | 0.5 |
| Roast beef slices, about 90 g | 160 | 25 | 0 | 6 |
| Noodles with beef, about 300 g | 480 | 18 | 60 | 18 |

Served total: about 1540 kcal.

I assumed about 15% is left over, roughly 230 kcal, so about 1310 kcal is eaten. Scaling the macronutrient totals the same way gives the eaten amounts below.
